title: Certify finite precision without recursive denominator growth
statement: Uniform center Hessian bounds convert a paid objective gap to a variational certificate. Repair in the unnormalized K=dZ variable, with a prescribed grid and separate rho, returns exact TP/PSD centers in a fixed rational denominator family. A rational dual-feasible SDP witness gives an upper residual bound accepted at delta, with strict slack; exact inverse dual preserves bit-estimator unbiasedness.

requires: The received small-loss learner native bit/source/privacy interface and declared finite rational parameters
Paid weak convex optimization, exact inverse dual, TP/PSD repair and rational SDP upper witnesses
Privately timed terminal payload or separately justified broader service; complete process implementation allowance
provides: A finite bit/control route whose precision does not inherit an exponential learner floor
assumptions: Theoretical weak-solve cap is not measured solver runtime
No learning-rate, sample-horizon or adverse-pilot improvement
costs: Per-round bit complexity polynomial in d/input bits/log accuracy, plus log(N/nu) synthesis precision
All N rounds, dense decoder applications, classical/control work, memory, privacy and failed acquisitions still paid
